title: Design system file
summary: Gives a new project a design system by writing a DESIGN.md based on one of 84 well known product brands.
benefit: A new project gets a consistent look from day one.
solves: A new project with no design system, so every screen ends up looking different.
use_cases: "/design-md list": shows 84 brand-inspired design systems, grouped by kind.
"/design-md stripe": writes a DESIGN.md for your project from that brand's look.
Brand names, logos and paid fonts are replaced, so the result is yours and not a copy.
A DESIGN.md already exists: Claude asks whether to replace it, merge into it or stop.
details: Type /design-md list to see 84 brand-inspired design systems, then /design-md with a brand name like Linear or Stripe to write a DESIGN.md for your new project. It helps when a new site has no design system yet and needs a look. The skill folder installs as skills/design-md and loads only when you use it; it is instructions only, so no code runs on its own.
risk: Instructions only; loads when used. No code runs on its own.
